assessments.name: Critical reflection focused on identity work for cultural competence
assessments.description: Students are required to construct a critical reflexive journal entry through which they will demonstrate their skills in critical self-reflection towards developing cultural competence.

assessments.name: Poster proposal for a justice-oriented occupational therapy practice
